name: tower-floors
about: The HoH1 Forsaken Tower (mods/campaign README, HoH1 tower): bot tower_floors loads the floors named in kwargs.floors with `gl mission hwp_forsaken_tower_hoh1 <i>` and checks each: level phase, clean log, the HoH1 generator's prefab count and start spot (generated floors), the player alive, enemies counted, a screenshot. Needs the HoH1 import. Several minutes a floor.

steps.name: hoh1.content on (off by default; saved with the town)
the tower floors load as HoH1 made them
